# The Monolith and the Remade
A Monolith is a black stone that gives power for free. The more you draw on it, the louder it gets. Loud enough and it turns the dead into the Remade and hunts the crew with them.
- [textlink="The Monolith and its Gifts" link="WFRemadeMonolith"]: what it gives, and what it costs. - [textlink="Fighting the Remade" link="WFRemadeFighting"]: what kills them, and what stops a corpse getting up. - [textlink="Ending an outbreak" link="WFRemadeEnding"]: what destroying a Monolith takes, and what happens if nobody does.
What the stones are, as far as anyone knows: [lorelink="The Monolith" link="WFLoreMonolith"].
Frontier Outpost is safe. No corruption grows on it or within 500 m of it, and a Monolith there can't be drawn on. Every other station can be taken.
